item.tib: drin chen bla ma'i sgrub pa las rgyan bkod skabs kyi las rim
item.coloph: ces pa'i skyabs gnas 'dus gtso drin chen bla ma'i sgrub pa bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba las/ rgyan bkod skabs kyi las rim 'di yang / mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal gyi gar rol/ spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags kyis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ ma zad rigs mthun grogs po brtse gdung gcig tu 'dres pa'i btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros kyi rten 'brel legs mtshon spyi blug dar dkar dri med kyis sna drangs nas bskul ba brten nas/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'breng tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod ba'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba des dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du drin chen bla ma de nyid mdun du bzhugs par byas shing skyo gdung gi snang ba dang bcas nas spel ba'o//
